items.headline: "Make sure it's your servant": great communication in the AI era
items.summary: Find out how to make the best of communication in an AI world without losing the human touch.

items.headline: Men Are Experiencing More Job Growth Than Women in AI-Exposed Occupations
items.summary: Men's employment grew faster than women's in occupations most exposed to AI, a gap driven largely by workers without a bachelor's degree.

items.headline: New AI shopping agents promise better bargains. But who pays the price?
items.summary: As AI agents begin shopping on our behalf, there's a real risk cheaper products could put more pressure on vulnerable workers in global supply chains.

items.headline: AI chatbots are becoming political advisers. Their answers can mislead voters
items.summary: Millions of Americans are turning to AI for election information, but chatbots are getting voting facts wrong and recommending candidates, raising concerns they could influence voters' decisions.

items.headline: AI is stealing Indigenous Australian art and churning out 'Temu slop', artist says
items.summary: Chair of National Gallery's First Nations advisory group says the technology is undermining artists' agency and the authenticity of their work

items.headline: What is it like to work when your co-workers are AI agents?
items.summary: Using AI for roles from executive assistants to chiefs of staff, companies are boasting about doing more with less, creating tension with their human workers
